title: Deterministic distill selection and immutable retirement

claims.text: distill copies parent_id/child_id and optional display_name, validates unit_ids as a non-string Sequence (bad_args otherwise), builds the agent_distill command, checks the child target via agents._target, and prepares an agent.born payload with op='distill'.
distill never paraphrases selected units; selection is deterministic through _birth_payload with the selected ids.

retire builds the agent_retire command, checks the target via agents._target, and transacts an agent.status payload from _retirement_payload so retirement preserves history instead of deleting the agent.

decision.rule: Change here when deterministic unit selection for distill or immutable retirement payload needs to change.
decision.failure: Distill mangles or drops selected units, rejects a valid unit collection, or retirement deletes agent history.

questions.q: Where does distill validate the unit_ids collection before building its command?
Where should I change how distill passes selected ids to _birth_payload?
Where can I debug why retire preserves history instead of deleting the agent?
